correctness.rationale: Every allowed cyclic triple a∈A,b∈B,c∈C has positive clockwise arc gaps p,q,r∈[1,m] summing a multiple of n=2m+1 but <=3m<2n, so sum=n and A,B,C occur in unique noninterlaced cyclic blocks. The first selected A after C is a unique anchor. Block widths u,v,w and gaps p,q,r satisfy all-to-all inequalities u+v+p<=m, v+w+q<=m, w+u+r<=m. Defining slacks i,j,k gives six nonnegative parameters u+v+w+i+j+k=m-1, and inverse positive gaps p=1+w+j+k etc; optional block interiors yield weight W(z,s)=s(1-z)/(1-(1+s)z). Three gap-slack factors (1-z)^-3 cancel W(z,s)^3 numerator, leaving n[z^(m-1)](1-(1+s)z)^-3=n C(m+1,2)(1+s)^(m-1). Rotation shifts the unique anchor, so cell stabilizer is trivial. Alternating sum zero for m>=2 implies noncontractibility of finite nonempty CW complex; m=1 is three vertices. Independently enumerated all ordered nonempty A,B,C satisfying actual arc constraints for target orders 3,5,7,9, reproducing e.g. R9 f=(90,270,270,90), not used to infer general m.
residual_risks: Counts are for original product-of-simplices regular cells, not simplices of a barycentric subdivision; quotient regularity and full homotopy type unclaimed.
